User Story: As an admin, I can create a tenant/workspace with isolated configs
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): Tenant isolation; audit; per-tenant secrets namespace

User Story: As a user, I can login via OIDC and receive a session token
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): OIDC login; refresh; logout; session timeout

User Story: As an admin, I can create roles and assign permissions
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): Role CRUD; permission checks for UI+API

User Story: As a data architect, I can define entities/attributes/relationships
As a platform, I generate SA/SD/MD/GD + history/error/dup tables
As an integration dev, I can init/submit/cancel loads with Load IDs
As a steward, I can configure validations and view errors
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): Rules run; errors stored; recycle UI

User Story: As a steward, I can run basic enrichers (text/email/phone)
As a business user, I can browse entities and child records
As compliance, I can see field-level change history
As an app dev, I can query and update data via REST
As an integration dev, I can load/query using SQL patterns
As a steward, I can see duplicate groups with match scores
As a steward, I can merge/split duplicates with audit
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): Compare; merge; split; audit; re-run consolidation

User Story: As an architect, I can define survivorship and overrides
As an integration dev, I can publish named queries as custom endpoints
Acceptance Criteria (DoD): Param schema; versioning; view selection; scopes

User Story: As an admin, I can notify downstream systems on changes
As a data owner, I can build stewardship workflows with routing
As a steward, I can see and act on assigned tasks
As a platform, I can run signed plugins safely
As a steward, I can extract/augment data using GenAI plugins
As an architect, I can push notifications to Kafka/JMS
As an admin, I can monitor loads/certification/notifications
As an admin, I can upgrade safely with rollback
